name: @repo/rust
description: The Cargo workspace as one turbo package. Cargo's unit of work is the workspace, not the crate: it takes a single lock on target/, so three per-crate packages would serialise on it and run slower than one workspace invocation (measured 320-365ms against 195ms). This package is therefore the node in the turbo graph that owns every cargo command; the crates underneath it stay pure Cargo members. Internal to the workspace (@repo/* convention), never published.

scripts.test: bun run test:unit && bun run test:doc
scripts.lint: bun run lint:fmt && bun run lint:clippy && bun run lint:deps
scripts.lint:deps: cargo deny --manifest-path ../Cargo.toml check bans licenses sources
